about_the_game:
* The demo allows you to play up to World 2.

[Story]

After the Ragnarok War, the world is destroyed, regenerated, and reborn.

But just as the gods do, humans also believe that war is a cycle of destruction and renewal

the cycle of destruction and rebirth.

A boy finds a pocket watch and encounters a figure named Norne.

Norne doesn't remember much of her life, but when she meets the boy, time stops, and the clock starts ticking.

time begins to flow for another cycle.

In the meantime, the daily lives, challenges, and survival stories of girls from various groups are told, centered on the boy.

centered around the boy.

[About the Coalition]

*St. Rosemary's Academy

A long-standing academy founded by Rosemary. It was established for war orphans after the end of the Aether War.

After a rigorous entrance examination, the school has attracted many talented students and trains them based on the philosophy of “fighting for peace”.

*Paul Bosque

A vassal state of the Lucian Empire ruled by Julia. It once held autonomy, but was stripped of it after a failed rebellion by its ancestral lords.

It is now under the Empire, but it is unknown how long its lord, Yulia, will listen to the Empire.

*Shabin Zara Top

An alliance of profit-driven merchants with sophisticated technology. Most of its members are cheerful and flamboyant, and operate on the principle of mutual trust and profit.

*Forest of Melody

A forest where spirits have gathered to form their own civilization in a place far removed from the rest of the world.

The spirits hate fighting and love peace, and under the leadership of Tosa Mikoto, they have a powerful spirit.

*Republic of Larok

A nation that once led an etheric revolution that led to a global war.

They lost the war and suffered great damage to their ecosystem, but are now working with St. Rosemary's Academy to educate people on the proper use of the aether.

in cooperation with St. Rosemary's Academy. Most of its citizens recognize the wrongdoings of their country.

[Gameplay]

*Players form teams of up to 5 beautiful girls.

*Each beautiful girl has 3 skills.

*Players can draw (submit) as many cards as the number of surviving beauties.

*Efficiently organize skills to defeat opponents within a set number of turns.

[Game Features]

*Collectible RPG genre with a variety of beautiful girls to acquire.

*High-quality cel animations for your ultimate skills

*Turn-based rules to overcome various stages through interaction between characters and their skills.
